## 1. 做了什么 / What

<!-- 改动内容与范围，可定位到提交哈希与文件路径。 / Changes and scope, locatable to commit hashes and file paths. -->

## 2. 为什么这么做 / Why

<!-- 动机、考虑过的备选方案与取舍、被放弃的方案及原因。 / Motivation, alternatives considered, tradeoffs, and reasons for rejected options. -->

## 3. 验证结果 / Verification

<!-- 运行的命令、实际结果、测试文件路径；区分“已实现并验证 / 已实现未验证 / 未实现”；未验证项与原因；风险与回退方式。 / Executed commands, actual results, test file paths; categorize as "Implemented and verified / Implemented but unverified / Not implemented"; unverified items and reasons; risks and rollback instructions. -->

### 验证状态 / Verification Status
- [ ] 已实现并验证 / Implemented and verified:
- [ ] 已实现未验证 / Implemented but unverified:
- [ ] 未实现 / Not implemented:

## PR Skills Checklist / PR Skills 检查清单

- [ ] Linting & code style checked / 已检查代码规范
- [ ] Change record or changelog updated / 已更新变更记录或 changelog
- [ ] Unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage considered / 已考虑单元、集成和端到端覆盖
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes reviewed / 已审查安全敏感变更
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits / commit message 符合 Conventional Commits
